newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse ends slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse ends slightly higher.

text.p: Morocco's bourse closed on Monday just 0.06 percent higher with many stocks trading within a tight range including ONA group, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 665.93 points from 665.53 points on Friday.
Morocco's largest private conglomerate, ONA Group edged up two dirhams to 832 dirhams while the second holding Societe Nationale d'Investissement was unchanged at 796 dirhams.

In the banking sector, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a very liquid stock, dropped nine dirhams to 571 dirhams. Banque Marocaine pour le Developpement Economique, shed two dirhams to 223 dirhams.
Credit du Maroc was up nine dirhams to 464 while Wafabank gained four dirhams to 870 dirhams.
In the energy sector, oil refinery Samir advanced two dirhams to 339 dirhams, Sonasid fell nine dirhams to 567 dirhams.

On the official market, total traded volume was 21 million dirhams. On the over-the-counter market trade totalled 10.2 million dirhams, the bourse said. Main trade on this market was in 2,060 shares of cement firm Lafarge Ciments, it added.
